title: Mom Starved Her Special Needs Son to Death
description:
A New Mexico Mom was arrested after her 5-year-old special needs child died in 2023. Police took Marcella Montelongo, 23, into custody after a caller reported an emergency regarding the kid. While in jail awaiting trial, Marcella died. Get all the details on this news report of Law&Crime BodyCam.
